title: Improving the Optimisation Landscape for Particle Mixtures
abstract: arXiv:2611.26931v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Several methods in statistics and machine learning represent a predictive distribution as an equally weighted mixture of models, or particles, trained via the mixture predictive likelihood. However, we prove that the mixture predictive likelihood is poorly suited to gradient-based optimisation, because it does not identify how the mixture is decomposed across particles, so that a poorly matched particle can be starved of training signal. As a remedy, we study a convex combination between the individual risk, i.e. the average log loss of the individual particles, and the mixture risk. At the particle level, this regularised risk imposes a reverse-KL barrier on the responsibilities of the particles, so that no particle can be starved of training signal. translated_title: 改进粒子混合的优化景观
translated_abstract: 统计学和机器学习中的若干方法将预测分布表示为模型（即粒子）的等权重混合，并通过混合预测似然进行训练。然而，我们证明混合预测似然并不适合基于梯度的优化，因为它无法识别混合如何在各粒子之间分解，导致匹配不佳的粒子可能得不到训练信号。作为补救措施，我们研究了个体风险（即各粒子的平均对数损失）与混合风险之间的凸组合。在粒子层面，这种正则化风险对粒子的责任施加了反向KL散度屏障，使得任何粒子都不会被剥夺训练信号。这些现象在两个案例研究中得到说明：在第一个案例中，使用平均场朗之万动力学计算面向预测的后验，且数值仅在有条件下表现良好（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文证明了混合预测似然在梯度优化中会使匹配不佳的粒子得不到训练信号，并提出将个体风险与混合风险进行凸组合的正则化方法，通过反向KL屏障确保每个粒子都能获得训练信号，从而改进了粒子混合的优化景观。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the mixture predictive likelihood starves poorly matched particles of training signal during gradient-based optimisation, and proposes a convex combination of individual and mixture risks that imposes a reverse-KL barrier on particle responsibilities, thereby improving the optimisation landscape for particle mixtures.
